DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの煮込みをご覧ですね。お味や材料について説明いたしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at this stew. Shall I explain its flavor and ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お酒の風味が苦手です。メニューに「酒蒸し」とある料理とは違いますが、この煮込みにも酒を使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 酒風味が苦手で酒蒸しとは違う煮込みにも酒を使うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not like the flavor of alcohol. This is different from the dish labeled “steamed in sake” on the menu, but does this stew also use sake?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you dislike alcohol flavor and ask whether this stew, unlike the sake-steamed dish, also uses sake.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 料理によって酒やみりんを使います。この煮込みの材料は厨房へ確認します。苦手な味は、ほかにもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Depending on the dish, we use sake or mirin. I will check this stew's ingredients with the kitchen. Are there any other flavors you dislike?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 唐辛子の辛さも苦手です。仕上げの薬味だけなら外せるのか、最初から汁に入っているのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 唐辛子が苦手で薬味だけなのか汁に最初から含まれるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I also do not like the heat of chili peppers. I want to know whether it is only a finishing garnish that can be removed or is included in the broth from the start.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you dislike chili and ask whether it is only a garnish or is already in the broth.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認したところ、この煮込みは仕込みの段階で酒と唐辛子を使っています。薬味を外しても、その二つは取り除けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked, and this stew uses sake and chili during preparation. Removing the garnish cannot remove those two ingredients.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では煮込みはやめます。この焼きおにぎりも、たれに酒や唐辛子が入るか確かめてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 煮込みをやめ焼きおにぎりのたれに酒や唐辛子があるか確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not have the stew. Could you check whether the sauce on this grilled rice ball also contains sake or chili?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline the stew in Japanese and ask the staff to check whether the grilled rice ball sauce contains sake or chili.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: たれの材料を確認します。今すぐ、お好みに合うと約束はできませんので、まだ注文にはしないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the sauce ingredients. I cannot promise immediately that it will suit your preferences, so I will not put it through as an order yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認してから決めます。飲み物は温かいお茶にしたいですが、無糖のものがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 材料確認後に料理を決め温かい無糖のお茶があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will decide after the check. For a drink I would like hot tea; do you have an unsweetened one?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will decide on food after the ingredient check and ask whether hot unsweetened tea is available.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: このお茶は砂糖を加えずにお出しします。お茶を先にご用意し、焼きおにぎりは材料の確認後にお知らせしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We serve this tea without added sugar. Shall I prepare the tea first and tell you about the grilled rice ball after checking its ingredients?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お茶だけ先にお願いします。焼きおにぎりも条件が合わなければ、ほかの料理を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: お茶を先に注文しおにぎりの条件が合わなければ別料理を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please bring only the tea first. If the grilled rice ball does not meet my conditions either, I will discuss another dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Order tea first in Japanese and say that you will discuss another dish if the rice ball is unsuitable.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 無糖の温かいお茶をご用意します。料理は確認してから伺いますので、どうぞゆっくりお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-MARUGAME-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will prepare hot unsweetened tea. We will ask about your food after checking, so please take your time choosing.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 加工前に材料札と図面を照合してください。番号は一致していますか。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before processing, please compare the material tag and drawing. Do the numbers match?

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 品番は同じですが、図面の改訂番号が違います。このまま加工してよいのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ品番で改訂番号だけ異なり加工可否を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-02.translation: The part number is the same, but the drawing revision number is different. I want to check whether I can process it as it is.
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the part number matches but only the revision differs, and you want to check whether processing is permitted.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 古い図面で加工すると寸法が違うおそれがあります。機械はまだ始動していませんか。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Processing from an old drawing could result in incorrect dimensions. Have you not started the machine yet?

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ始動していません。材料も固定せず、図面と札を並べて見ています。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 始動も材料固定もしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not started it. I have not clamped the material either; I am looking at the drawing and tag side by side.
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have neither started the machine nor secured the material.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま待ってください。私も最新版を決める権限はないので、工程の担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait as you are. I do not have the authority to decide which version is current either, so let us check with the person responsible for the process.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 図面は改訂二、材料札は改訂三です。違う箇所を担当に伝えればいいですね。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図面改訂二と札改訂三を照合して伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-06.translation: The drawing is revision two, and the material tag is revision three. I should tell the responsible person where they differ, correct?
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the comparison between drawing revision two and tag revision three in Japanese.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号と、始動前に気づいたことを伝えてください。確認済みの材料と混ざらないようにしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them the numbers and that you noticed before starting. Let us keep this separate from materials that have already been checked.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この材料は作業台に残します。次の材料へ勝手に切り替えるのも、待ったほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認材料を残し次の材料へ切替えてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave this material on the workbench. Should I also wait rather than switch to the next material on my own?
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the unconfirmed material in place and ask whether you may switch to the next one.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 作業順序も担当の指示を受けてください。図面を自分で書き換えたり、設定値を推測したりしないでください。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the responsible person's instructions on the work sequence too. Do not alter the drawing yourself or guess the settings.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号の違いを報告して指示を待ちます。使う図面が決まってから、設定の確認を受けます。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不一致を報告し図面決定と設定確認後に作業する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the number mismatch and wait for instructions. After the drawing to use has been decided, I will have the settings checked.
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report the mismatch and work only after the drawing has been decided and the settings checked.

DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図面と材料札の情報を担当に示して相談しましょう。それでは、機械は動かさず、この材料の確認から進めます。
DLG-SC-KGW-SAKAIDE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us show the drawing and material-tag information to the responsible person and consult them. We will begin by checking this material without running the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り継ぎについてのご相談でしょうか。きっぷを確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about a connection? May I check your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 遅れている列車から、この予約列車へ乗り継ぐ予定です。接続できるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延列車から予約便へ接続予定で心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to connect from a delayed train to this reserved train. I am worried about whether I can make the connection.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to connect from a delayed train to a reserved service and are worried.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約した時刻と乗り換える駅を確認します。現在の遅延だけでは、接続できると断言できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your reserved time and transfer station. The current delay alone does not let me say definitively that you can make the connection.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 接続を待ってもらえると思い込まないほうがいいですね。乗れなかった場合の手続きも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 接続待ちを前提にせず乗れない場合の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I should not assume they will hold the connecting train, then. I would also like to ask about the procedure if I cannot board it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume the connection will wait, and ask what happens if you miss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お持ちのきっぷの種類や運行状況で扱いが変わります。まず、予約内容を確認して相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The handling depends on your ticket type and operating conditions. First let us check your booking details and discuss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この予約画面もあります。紙のきっぷと両方見せれば、条件を調べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙のきっぷと予約画面の両方で条件確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also have this booking screen. Could you check the conditions if I show both it and the paper ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the conditions to be checked against both the paper ticket and booking screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方を照合します。今の案内を確認したうえで、乗り継ぎ先の係員への相談方法もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will compare both. After checking the current guidance, I will also explain how to consult staff at the connecting station.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗り換えの駅で迷ったら、走って探すより係員に聞きたいです。どの情報を見せればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 走り回らず係員へ尋ねる際に示す情報を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I get confused at the transfer station, I would rather ask staff than run around looking. What information should I show them?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese what information to show staff rather than running around looking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約列車の名前と時刻がわかるものを見せ、遅れた列車から来たことを伝えてください。変更を自己判断で済ませないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show something with the reserved train's name and time, and tell them you came from the delayed train. Do not treat a change as settled based on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約情報をすぐ出せるようにします。接続できなければ、きっぷを見せて次の扱いを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約情報を用意して係員へきっぷの扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the reservation information ready to show. If I cannot make the connection, I will show my ticket and ask what to do next.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will prepare the reservation information and consult staff about your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 最新の放送も聞いておいてください。それでは、きっぷと予約画面をお忘れなく、落ち着いて移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please also listen for the latest announcements. Remember your ticket and booking screen, and move calmly.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この二つの箱を見比べてください。外観は似ていますが、配送先コードを読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please compare these two boxes. They look similar, but can you read the destination codes?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 片方は末尾が八、もう片方は末尾がＢに見えます。読み間違えそうなので、一緒に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 末尾の八とＢを読み間違えそうで照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: One looks as though it ends in an eight and the other in a B. I might misread them, so I want to check together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you may confuse the final eight and B and request a comparison.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 数字と英字を区別して、出荷指示と照合しましょう。ラベルをはがして書き直すことはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us distinguish numbers from letters and compare them with the shipping instructions. Do not peel off the labels and rewrite them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 指示書では別々の配送先ですね。まだ台車には載せていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指示書では別の宛先で台車未積載と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instruction sheet gives different destinations. I have not loaded either onto the trolley yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the instructions show different destinations and the boxes have not been loaded onto the trolley.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 取り違えを防ぐため、確認できた箱から指定された置き場へ運びましょう。運搬経路もわかっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: To avoid mixing them up, let us carry each box to its designated place after it is checked. Do you also know the transport route?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いつもの通路に空のパレットがありました。別の通路を通ってよいか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: パレットが通路をふさぎ別経路の使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: There was an empty pallet in the usual passage. I would like to check whether I may take a different passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a pallet blocks the passage and ask whether another route can be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勝手に近道せず、使える経路を責任者に確認します。車両が通る場所もあるので、今は待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do not take a shortcut on your own; we will check which route is available with the person in charge. Vehicles use some areas too, so wait for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を置いたまま待ちます。先に通路を空けるため、パレットを自分で動かす必要はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を置いて待ちパレットを自分で動かすべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will leave the goods in place and wait. Do I need to move the pallet myself first to clear the passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will leave the goods and wait, and ask whether you should move the pallet yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: パレットの移動も担当の指示を受けてください。運ぶ箱のコードと、止まっている理由を報告しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also obtain the responsible person's instructions for moving the pallet. Let us report the code of the box to be moved and why work is stopped.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 似たコードを照合したことと、通路がふさがっていることを伝えます。経路の指示が出てから運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: コード照合と通路閉塞を報告し経路指示後に運搬する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report that we compared the similar codes and that the passage is blocked. I will carry them after receiving route instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report the code comparison and blocked passage and transport the boxes after route instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 箱を取り違えないよう、指示とラベルをもう一度合わせてください。それでは、経路の確認が済むまでこの置き場で待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please compare the instructions and labels once again to avoid mixing up the boxes. Let us wait in this storage area until the route has been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃の担当範囲を確認しています。設備の近くで何か気づきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are checking the area you are responsible for cleaning. Did you notice anything near the equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 紙くずが機械の下に落ちています。今動いているので、手を伸ばして取ってよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 稼働設備下の紙くずに手を伸ばしてよいか迷ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is scrap paper under the machine. It is running now, so I was unsure whether I could reach in and take it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you were unsure whether to reach for scrap paper beneath operating equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動いている設備へ手を入れないでください。清掃する範囲には、稼働中の設備内部は含まれていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not put your hand into running equipment. Your cleaning area does not include the inside of equipment while it is operating.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手は入れていません。ほうきなら届きそうですが、それも今は使わないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手を入れずほうきも差し込まないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not put my hand in. A broom might reach it, but I should not use that now either, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you have not put your hand in and will not insert a broom either.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道具を差し込むこともやめてください。必要な停止や安全確認は、担当者へ依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not insert tools either. We will ask the responsible staff to carry out any necessary stopping and safety checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で停止ボタンを押して掃除するのではなく、落ちている場所を報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己停止せず紙の落ちた場所を担当へ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than press the stop button and clean it myself, I will report where the paper has fallen.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report the paper's location rather than stop the machine yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 私からも担当へ伝えます。設備の外の通路にも紙が落ちていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also tell the responsible staff. Is there paper in the passage outside the equipment too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外の通路には少しあります。そこは今回の清掃範囲ですが、機械に近づかず片づけられるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路の紙が範囲内でも近づかず片づけられるか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a little in the outside passage. That is part of today's cleaning area, but I want to check whether I can clear it without getting close to the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that although the passage paper is within your area, you want to check whether you can remove it without approaching the machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 清掃範囲と境界を担当に見てもらってから始めましょう。安全にできると確認されるまで待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us begin after the responsible staff inspect the cleaning area and boundary. Please wait until they confirm that it can be done safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当者に場所を見てもらいます。機械の下と通路を区別して伝え、指示された範囲だけ掃除します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の現地確認後に指示された範囲だけ清掃する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have them look at the locations. I will distinguish the paper under the machine from the passage paper and clean only the area I am instructed to clean.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will clean only the instructed area after the responsible staff check the site.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 紙を取るために無理をしないでください。それでは、担当者が来るまで設備から離れて待ちましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not take risks just to remove paper. Let us wait away from the equipment until the responsible staff arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は何名様で、どのくらいの時間をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: How many people will be using the room today, and for how long?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は二人で一時間です。友人が一人、途中で来る予定なので、料金の数え方を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で一時間、途中から一人追加する料金を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: At first, two people for one hour. One friend plans to arrive partway through, so I would like to know how the charges are calculated.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about charges for two people for one hour with one person joining partway through.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 途中参加の方の扱いを料金案内で確認します。来られる時刻は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the pricing guidance for someone joining later. Do you know what time they will arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事が終わってからなので、まだ決まっていません。来たら受付で人数を追加する形ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の時刻未定で到着時に人数追加するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They will come after work, so the time is not decided yet. When they arrive, do we add them to the headcount at reception?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your friend's arrival time is uncertain and ask whether to add them to the headcount on arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入室前に受付へお知らせください。時間の計算と追加料金は、条件を確認してご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell reception before they enter the room. We will explain time calculation and additional charges after checking the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 全員がそろうまで自動で延長になることはないですよね。一時間で終わりたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自動延長を望まず一時間で終了したいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It will not extend automatically until everyone arrives, will it? I would like to finish after one hour.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you do not want an automatic extension and want to finish after one hour.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 終了時刻の希望も確認します。延長の条件を先にご覧ください。飲み物の注文についても説明が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also confirm your intended finishing time. Please look at the extension conditions first. Would you like an explanation of drink orders too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。室料だけで利用できるのか、飲み物の注文が必須なのかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 室料のみか飲み物注文必須か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I would also like to know whether we can use the room for the room charge alone or whether ordering drinks is compulsory.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the room charge alone is sufficient or drink orders are required.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらのプランごとの注文条件を確認しましょう。人数が増えた場合に、注文条件がどうなるかもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check each plan's ordering conditions here. We will also explain how those conditions apply if the number of people increases.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 途中参加と飲み物の条件を聞いてからプランを選びます。友人には、先に受付へ寄るよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 条件確認後に選び友人へ受付に寄るよう知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose a plan after hearing the late-arrival and drink conditions. I will tell my friend to stop at reception first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose after checking the conditions and tell your friend to visit reception first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 終了時刻と合計の見込みを確認してからご案内します。それでは、お友達の追加についても忘れず受付へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will show you in after confirming the finishing time and estimated total. Please remember to inform reception about your additional friend too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 接種予約についてのご相談ですね。予約した日時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a vaccination appointment, correct? Please tell me the date and time you booked.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の火曜午前です。仕事の予定が変わったので、別の日に変更できるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来週火曜午前の予約を仕事変更で別日にしたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Next Tuesday morning. My work schedule has changed, so I would like to ask whether I can move it to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to change next Tuesday morning's appointment because of a work-schedule change.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約情報を確認します。ご希望の日はありますか。接種の日程によっては医師への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the booking. Is there a day you prefer? Depending on the vaccination schedule, we may need to check with a doctor.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 翌週の金曜なら来られます。ただ、間隔の条件があるなら自分で日を決めないほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌週金曜希望だが接種間隔条件なら自己判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can come on Friday of the following week. However, if there are interval requirements, I should not choose the date on my own, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you prefer Friday of the following week but will not decide independently if vaccination-interval conditions apply.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 接種の種類と予定を確認してから変更先を検討します。元の予約を残したまま、新しく予約することは避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will consider a new date after checking the vaccination type and schedule. Please avoid making a new booking while leaving the original one in place.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の予約がどうなるかも確認します。変更が決まるまでは、別の予約を自分で取りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元の予約扱いを確認し変更前に新規予約しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will also check what happens to the original appointment. I will not make a separate booking myself before the change has been decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm how the original appointment is handled and will not make a new booking before the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認のため、接種についての手元の書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could you show me the vaccination documents you have so we can check?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この案内と接種の記録を持っています。どこを見れば今回の種類がわかるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内と記録を示し今回の接種種類の記載を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have this information sheet and vaccination record. Please tell me where it says which type this vaccination is.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the information and record in Japanese and ask where the current vaccination type is stated.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類の名称を確認しましょう。変更できる日程と、当日持参する物は担当から改めてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the document titles. The responsible staff will give you further guidance about available dates and what to bring on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日程の返答を待ちます。変更が決まったら、新しい日時と元の予約の取り扱いをメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返答を待ち新日時と元の予約扱いをメモすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the reply about dates. Once the change is decided, I will note the new date and time and how the original appointment is handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for the reply and note the new appointment and the handling of the original booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 変更のご案内が出るまでは予定を確定させずお待ちください。それでは、書類をお返しするまでこちらの席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait without finalizing your plans until the change guidance is issued. Please stay in this seat until we return your documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: リハビリ室への移動をお手伝いします。今日は歩く前に気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will help you move to the rehabilitation room. Is there anything concerning you before walking today?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝から体がだるくて、いつもより歩くのがつらいです。このままリハビリを始めてよいか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝からだるく歩行がつらいため開始可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have felt sluggish since this morning, and walking is harder than usual. I would like to ask whether I should begin rehabilitation like this.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have felt sluggish since morning and find walking difficult, and ask whether rehabilitation should begin.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今は移動せず、医療の担当に体調を伝えましょう。私は訓練内容を変更する判断はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not move for now; let us tell the medical staff about your condition. I cannot make decisions about changing the training content.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いつもの運動を少なくすればよいと、自分で決めないほうがいいですね。座ったまま待てますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 運動量を自分で変えず座って待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I should not decide myself that simply doing less of my usual exercise will be enough, correct? May I wait seated?
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may wait seated rather than changing the exercise quantity yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 安全に座れる場所でお待ちください。症状が変わったら、その場で知らせてください。いつからだるいかも伝えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please wait somewhere you can sit safely. If your symptoms change, tell us there immediately. Can you also explain when the sluggish feeling started?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 起きたときからです。昨日の訓練中には感じませんでしたが、今日は立つと特につらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 起床時からで昨日はなく立位で特につらいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It started when I woke up. I did not feel it during yesterday's training, but today it is especially difficult when I stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it began on waking, was absent yesterday, and is especially difficult when standing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いも担当へ伝えます。立って確かめようとせず、今の状態を言葉で説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will tell the staff about that difference too. Do not stand up to test it; describe your current condition in words.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 立ち上がらず待ちます。医療の担当が来たら、起床時からのだるさを自分でも説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 立たず待ち起床からのだるさを本人も説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait without standing up. When the medical staff arrive, I will also explain the sluggishness since waking myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait without standing and personally explain the sluggishness since waking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が判断した内容を聞き、わからない点は確認しましょう。私はその後の移動を必要に応じてお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us hear the staff's decision and check anything unclear. Afterwards I will help you move as necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 実施するか休むかの説明を聞いてから動きます。途中でつらくなった場合の知らせ方も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実施や休止の説明後に動き体調悪化時の知らせ方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move after hearing whether to go ahead or rest. I will also check how to tell someone if I start feeling worse partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will move after hearing whether to proceed or stop and will check how to report worsening symptoms.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 体調を先に伝えてくださってありがとうございます。それでは、担当を呼んできますので、立ち上がらずこの場所でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for telling us about your condition first. I will call the responsible staff, so please wait here without standing up.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の確認についてですね。どのような案内が届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check a notice. What kind of notice did you receive?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申告内容を確認したいという通知です。追加で税金を払えという意味なのか、まず書類を出すのかがわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申告確認通知について追加納付か資料提出か不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says they want to check my tax return information. I do not know whether that means paying extra tax or first submitting documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a tax-return check notice leaves you unsure whether extra payment or submission of materials is requested.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 文面を確認して、求められている対応を区別しましょう。確認事項の欄を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us read the text and distinguish the response requested. Could you show me the section listing what needs checking?

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに収入の内訳と書かれています。去年は勤務先が二つあったので、どの資料を示せばよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 収入内訳の欄を示し勤務先二社の資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “Breakdown of income” here. I had two employers last year, so I want to know which documents to show.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the income-breakdown field and ask in Japanese about documents for two employers.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 勤務先ごとの資料をお持ちでしょうか。資料がそろっているかも含め、通知を担当に確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have documents from each employer? Let us have the responsible staff check the notice, including whether your documents are complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一社分はありますが、もう一社分を探しています。見つからなければ勤務先へ問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一社分あり他社分を探して必要なら勤務先へ問い合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have one company's documents, but I am looking for the other company's. If I cannot find them, I will contact the employer.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have one employer's documents, are looking for the other's, and will contact the employer if necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 不足がある場合はその状況も担当へ伝えてください。返答の期限と提出方法は通知の指定を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If anything is missing, please tell the responsible staff about that situation too. Let us check the response deadline and submission method specified in the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 期限はこちらの日付ですね。郵送するなら原本が必要か、写しでよいかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限日を確認し郵送時に原本か写しか尋ねたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The deadline is this date, correct? If I mail the documents, I also want to check whether originals are required or copies are acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the deadline date and say in Japanese that you want to ask whether mailed documents must be originals or may be copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類の種類ごとに扱いを確認してから送ってください。通知の指定が不明なら、記載の担当へ問い合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check how each document type is handled before sending them. If the notice's instructions are unclear, contact the staff listed on it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 不足資料と原本の要否を担当へ聞きます。期限までにそろわない見込みなら、先にそのことを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足と原本要否を聞き期限に間に合わなければ事前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask them about the missing documents and whether originals are necessary. If I expect they will not be ready by the deadline, I will consult them about that beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will ask about missing documents and originals and consult in advance if they will not be ready by the deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認の通知だけで納付額を推測せず、指定された返答を整理しましょう。それでは、通知と手元の資料を持って担当の案内をお受けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KGW-SAKAIDE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Do not infer the tax amount just from a checking notice; let us organize the requested response. Please take the notice and materials you have and receive the responsible staff's guidance.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ようこそ授与所へ。お守りをご覧になりますか、それともお納めのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome to the amulet office. Would you like to see amulets, or ask about returning one?

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年いただいたお守りを持ってきました。ここへお返ししてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨年受けたお守りを返せるか授与所で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought an amulet I received last year. May I return it here?
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese at the amulet office whether you may return an amulet received last year.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらで受けられたものか教えてください。この神社のものであれば、納める場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me where you received it. If it is from this shrine, I will show you where to return it.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらで受けたものです。袋に入れたままですが、袋ごと納めますか。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: この神社のお守りだと伝え、持参袋も納めるのか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I received it here. It is still in the bag I brought; should I place the bag there too?
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the amulet is from this shrine and confirm whether your carrying bag should be returned with it.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お守りはあちらの納め所へ、持参された袋はお持ち帰りください。もしほかの品もあるなら、入れる前にお声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please place the amulet at the return point over there and take your own bag home. If you have other items as well, please speak to us before putting them in.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋は持ち帰ります。今日は、自転車で通勤を始める弟のお守りも受けたいです。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋を持ち帰ると答え、自転車通勤を始める弟のお守りを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will take the bag home. Today I would also like an amulet for my younger brother, who is starting to commute by bicycle.
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take the bag home and want an amulet for your younger brother starting a bicycle commute.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに交通安全のお守りがあります。ひも付きのものと、薄い形のものが並んでいます。弟さんはどこに持つ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have traffic-safety amulets here. There are ones with cords and thin ones side by side. Where does your brother plan to keep it?

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 財布に入れたいと言っていたので、薄い方にします。贈るときに伝える扱い方はありますか。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布に入る薄い形を選び、贈る際に知らせる扱い方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-08.translation: He said he would like to put it in his wallet, so I will choose the thin one. Is there any handling guidance I should pass on when giving it to him?
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the thin wallet-sized amulet and ask in Japanese what handling guidance to tell the recipient.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 大切に持っていただくようお伝えください。お守りがあるから危険を避けられると考えず、毎日の安全確認も続けていただければと思います。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell him to keep it with care. We hope he will continue his daily safety checks rather than assume that having an amulet will prevent danger.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 安全運転も忘れないように伝えます。この薄いお守りを一つお願いします。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全運転の注意も弟へ伝え、薄いお守り一つを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell him not to forget safe riding too. Please give me one of these thin amulets.
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will remind your brother about safe riding and request one thin amulet.

DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 一つお渡ししますね。古いお守りの納め所は右手です。弟さんにもよろしくお伝えください。
DLG-SC-KGW-ZENTSUJI-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you one. The return point for old amulets is on the right. Please give my regards to your brother too.
